# UnitSwift

> UnitSwift is a free, fast, client-side online unit converter offering 105 dedicated calculators across weight, length, temperature, volume, speed, area, local units, and data with no sign-up and no tracking.

## Weight Converters

- [Kilograms to Pounds Converter (kg to lb)](https://unitswift.org/kg-to-pounds): Convert kilograms to pounds using pounds = kilograms × 2.20462262.
- [Pounds to Kilograms Converter (lb to kg)](https://unitswift.org/pounds-to-kg): Convert pounds to kilograms using kilograms = pounds × 0.45359237.
- [Grams to Ounces Converter (g to oz)](https://unitswift.org/gram-to-ounce): Convert grams to ounces using ounces = grams ÷ 28.3495231.
- [Ounces to Grams Converter (oz to g)](https://unitswift.org/ounce-to-gram): Convert ounces to grams using grams = ounces × 28.3495231.

## Temperature Converters

- [Celsius to Fahrenheit Converter (°C to °F)](https://unitswift.org/celsius-to-fahrenheit): Convert Celsius to Fahrenheit using °F = (°C × 1.8) + 32.
- [Fahrenheit to Celsius Converter (°F to °C)](https://unitswift.org/fahrenheit-to-celsius): Convert Fahrenheit to Celsius using °C = (°F − 32) ÷ 1.8.
- [Celsius to Kelvin Converter (°C to K)](https://unitswift.org/celsius-to-kelvin): Convert Celsius to Kelvin using K = °C + 273.15.
- [Kelvin to Celsius Converter (K to °C)](https://unitswift.org/kelvin-to-celsius): Convert Kelvin to Celsius using °C = K − 273.15.
- [Fahrenheit to Kelvin Converter (°F to K)](https://unitswift.org/fahrenheit-to-kelvin): Convert Fahrenheit to Kelvin using K = (°F − 32) × 5/9 + 273.15.

## Speed Converters

- [MPH to KM/H Speed Converter (mph to km/h)](https://unitswift.org/mph-to-kmh): Convert miles per hour to kilometers per hour using km/h = mph × 1.609344.
- [KM/H to MPH Speed Converter (km/h to mph)](https://unitswift.org/kmh-to-mph): Convert kilometers per hour to miles per hour using mph = km/h ÷ 1.609344.
- [KM/H to m/s Speed Converter (km/h to m/s)](https://unitswift.org/kmh-to-ms): Convert kilometers per hour to meters per second using m/s = km/h ÷ 3.6.
- [m/s to KM/H Speed Converter (m/s to km/h)](https://unitswift.org/ms-to-kmh): Convert meters per second to kilometers per hour using km/h = m/s × 3.6.
- [Knots to KM/H Speed Converter (kn to km/h)](https://unitswift.org/knots-to-kmh): Convert knots to kilometers per hour using km/h = knots × 1.852.

- [TB to GB Converter (Terabytes to Gigabytes)](https://unitswift.org/tb-to-gb): Convert terabytes to gigabytes using GB = TB × 1,024.
